Overview

Chihuahua is a city in Chihuahua with a population of 937,674. The capital of Chihuahua state with a rich cowboy heritage, stunning natural surroundings, and growing industry. Housing is more affordable than the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 5b growing zone supports Cool — many vegetables, some fruit trees. A large share of residents hold a bachelor’s degree or higher. The city enjoys abundant sunshine, with about 250 sunny days a year. Reported crime rates are relatively high.
